name: WdCellVerticalAlignment
description: Specifies the vertical alignment of text in one or more cells of a table.

constants.name: wdCellAlignVerticalTop
constants.description: Text is aligned to the top border of the cell.

constants.name: wdCellAlignVerticalCenter
constants.description: Text is aligned to the center of the cell.

constants.name: wdCellAlignVerticalBottom
constants.description: Text is aligned to the bottom border of the cell.
